concept.reason: Real multiview skull, skull/mandible occlusion photo, original limb dimensions and explicit scientific limits suffice without extra concept image.

scope: Whole heavy low-bodied pyrothere with six projecting incisor tusks and a short proboscis concept, explicitly uncertain in soft-tissue length.

scientific_limits.en: No complete articulated skeleton establishes whole-body proportions. ACM3207 skull and isolated limb measurements constrain an original reconstruction. Retracted nares and muscle attachments support a proboscis, but no preserved trunk determines its length. Billet2010 infers a very large trunk; this original short-proboscis concept is a transparent alternative soft-tissue choice, not demonstrated anatomy. Hands and distal feet are incompletely known; some historic attributed manus were later reassigned to astrapotheres. Coat, ears and tail inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 无完整关联骨架可确定全体比例；以ACM3207真颅与孤立肢骨测量约束原创复原。后缩鼻孔及肌附着支持软鼻，但无保存鼻软组织能确定长度；Billet2010推断大发达鼻，本原目标短鼻concept为明确标注的另一软组织方案，不作实证。手与远端足不全，历史部分所谓手骨后来改归其他类群。皮肤、耳尾为推断。

classification: Pyrotheria, Pyrotheriidae, Mammalia; precise higher affinities debated, not labeled an elephant

scale.source_status: Loomis1914 original measurements and cited Gaudry values, not one complete skeleton.
scale.model_status: Whole-body and soft-tissue dimensions are original estimates; trunk length explicitly uncertain, not measured.

diagnostic_targets: Massive deep elongated torso, low broad stance and stout limbs, not tall narrow modern elephant silhouette.
Elongate relatively narrow head with high retracted nasal region and short flexible proboscis concept above the tusk arcade.
Four upper incisor tusks in two bilateral pairs and two lower incisor tusks, projecting predominantly forward; do not reduce to two elephant tusks or invent canine sabers.
Upper incisors relatively straight/oblique with beveled tips, lower pair procumbent meeting upper arcade at acute angle, not warthog spirals.
Broad supporting plantigrade foot masses informed by genus tarsal study; no exact complete preserved digit-count claim.
Small inferred ears, restrained neutral skin and moderate tail; no African-elephant ears or rhino horn.
acceptance: Full original heavy low wholebody, prominent tusks and short-proboscis concept remain jointly readable.
Front/top/perspective distinguish all three bilateral tusk pairs and keep nose separate from teeth.
Side retains forward tusk projection, deep torso and shorter stout supports, not generic elephant.
Metadata explicitly admits short trunk length conjecture and incomplete postcranial constraints.
Four exactGLB views, two isolated rebuilds, independent review required.
